data.description: Cross Fit is a frame built for bodyweight training, with monkey bars, pull-up bars and several exercise stations on one structure. Users can hang and travel along the monkey bars, do pull-ups at different heights and use the other stations for push and core work. It suits younger, stronger users such as college students, sports clubs and corporate fitness groups, and it gives a society gym a training area that feels different from the usual machines. Cross Fit comes in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range. Ask us for the station list and a drawing before you plan the space. Our standard terms cover galvanised pipes for 3 years, and the warranty for Cross Fit will be confirmed in your quote.

items.pText: Cross Fit is a frame built for bodyweight training, with monkey bars, pull-up bars and several exercise stations on one structure. Users can hang and travel along the monkey bars, do pull-ups at different heights and use the other stations for push and core work. It suits younger, stronger users such as college students, sports clubs and corporate fitness groups, and it gives a society gym a training area that feels different from the usual machines. Cross Fit comes in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range. Ask us for the station list and a drawing before you plan the space. Our standard terms cover galvanised pipes for 3 years, and the warranty for Cross Fit will be confirmed in your quote.

Users hang from the bars and drop to the ground, so lay rubber flooring under the whole frame rather than just around it. Cross Fit is normally grouted because of the hanging loads. With no bearings in a bar frame, maintenance is mainly checking bolts, welds and the grip surface of the bars.
